{
  "project_id": "P-SRB-CompetitivenessJobs",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Weak inter‑ministerial policy coordination may delay PPMC implementation.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish clear PPMC mandate, schedule regular WG meetings, enforce reporting and performance reviews.",
      "evidence": "Weak strategic planning and policy coordination identified; PPMC framework to be piloted (Section 24‑26)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Insufficient procurement capacity in PPS and MoLEVSA could cause delays and non‑compliance.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Hire experienced procurement specialists, provide intensive training, and implement Bank oversight of procurement processes.",
      "evidence": "Assessment found most entities lack World Bank project experience; capacity issue addressed by hiring procurement experts (Section 86‑87)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Results‑based financing depends on achieving DLIs; failure reduces loan disbursements.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement robust monitoring, early verification of DLIs, and allocate contingency TA to support indicator achievement.",
      "evidence": "Disbursement‑linked indicators condition loan repayments; failure to meet DLIs reduces funding (Section 58‑60)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Payroll data integrity risk may affect eligibility of salary reimbursements.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct regular audits, cross‑checks, enforce segregation of duties, and review IT logs periodically.",
      "evidence": "Centralized payroll system deemed reliable but IT logs not regularly reviewed (Section 14‑15)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "High variance in NES caseworker caseload reduces labor intermediation effectiveness.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Introduce caseworker certification, redistribute staff, and implement active‑jobseeker registry to balance workloads.",
      "evidence": "NES caseworker caseload ranges 200‑2000; new active‑jobseeker list proposed to reduce dispersion (Section 46‑47)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Innovation Fund may not meet 80% matching‑grant budget commitment, limiting enterprise innovation.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Strengthen IF governance, monitor grant allocations, and ensure budget commitments are met each fiscal year.",
      "evidence": "Innovation Fund governance strong; DLI requires 80% of matching‑grant budget committed annually (Section 37‑38)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Technology Transfer Facility lacks functional capacity, risking insufficient technology transfer transactions.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Design service lines, allocate EUR 0.9 m annually, pilot transactions, and evaluate for scaling.",
      "evidence": "No existing TT facility; DLI 4 mandates design and deployment of service lines and funding (Section 31‑33)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Overlapping mandates of MoE agencies may hinder effective restructuring.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Define clear legal bases, streamline mandates, set performance targets, and conduct stakeholder consultations.",
      "evidence": "MoE agencies have overlapping mandates and non‑transparent performance (Section 30‑31)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Fiscal consolidation could limit funding for ALMPs and NES reforms.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Embed reforms in existing budget lines, prioritize cost‑effective measures, and seek donor co‑financing where needed.",
      "evidence": "Fiscal consolidation and upcoming SOE restructuring may limit ALMP budget (Section 50‑51)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "High tax wedge and benefit withdrawal create work disincentives for low‑wage workers.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Design in‑work cash transfer, adjust tax/benefit formulas, and pilot the program for formal job uptake.",
      "evidence": "High tax wedge and benefit withdrawal create work disincentives; DLI 9 targets cash‑transfer pilot (Section 51‑53)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Insufficient stakeholder engagement may reduce uptake of reforms.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Maintain ongoing consultations, conduct citizen surveys, and publish progress reports to keep stakeholders informed.",
      "evidence": "Extensive consultations with NGOs, business groups and public surveys planned (Section 18‑19)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "External macro‑economic risk from IMF program and debt sustainability could affect project environment.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Monitor IMF compliance, maintain fiscal discipline, and adjust reform pace if macro conditions deteriorate.",
      "evidence": "Three‑year IMF Precautionary Stand‑By Agreement approved Feb 2015 (Section 3‑4)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Potential environmental impacts from innovation activities not fully screened.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Apply ESMF screening to all activities, prepare EMPs where required, and conduct environmental monitoring.",
      "evidence": "Project classified as Category B; ESMF prepared and public consultation held (Section 89‑90)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Gender gaps may persist if gender analysis is not effectively integrated.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate gender indicators, monitor female participation, and adjust programs based on gender‑disaggregated data.",
      "evidence": "Gender analysis incorporated in components 4.C and 4.B; gender‑disaggregated stats to be monitored (Section 17‑18)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Delay in adoption of R&I strategy and sector reforms could stall innovation outcomes.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Set firm adoption deadlines, track progress quarterly, and provide targeted technical assistance.",
      "evidence": "DLI 5 requires adoption of R&I strategy and sector reforms by 2015‑2020 (Section 42‑44)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Perceived corruption may affect procurement and TA contract integrity.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Enforce transparency, publish contracts, conduct anti‑corruption training, and maintain Bank oversight.",
      "evidence": "Perceived corruption high; mitigation includes transparency, publishing contracts and Bank oversight (Section 32‑33)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "NES KPI data system may not be fully operational, limiting monitoring of labor reforms.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop IT platform, train staff, and perform regular data quality audits.",
      "evidence": "NES to develop KPI system with semi‑annual reports; risk of data quality if not implemented (Section 41‑42)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Results‑based financing schedule may misalign with fiscal calendar, causing cash‑flow gaps.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Synchronize DLI reporting with budget cycles and maintain contingency reserves for interim financing.",
      "evidence": "Disbursements tied to semi‑annual DLI reporting; retroactive financing limited to 12 months (Section 84‑86)."
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Weak inter‑ministerial policy coordination may delay PPMC implementation.
risks.mitigation: Establish clear PPMC mandate, schedule regular WG meetings, enforce reporting and performance reviews.
risks.evidence: Weak strategic planning and policy coordination identified; PPMC framework to be piloted (Section 24‑26).

risks.description: Insufficient procurement capacity in PPS and MoLEVSA could cause delays and non‑compliance.
